annonces_titres: select count(*) actives, count(*) filter (where titre ~* '^dakar, s[ée]n[ée]gal') titre_prefixe_dakar, count(*) filter (where titre ~ '(\d[ .]?){2}\d{3}[ .]?\d{2}[ .]?\d{2}' or titre ~ '7[05-8][ .]?\d{3}[ .]?\d{2}[ .]?\d{2}') titre_avec_tel, count(*) filter (where description ~ '(\S ){12,}') desc_lettres_espacees, count(*) filter (where description ~ '7[05-8][ .]?\d{3}[ .]?\d{2}[ .]?\d{2}' or description ~* 'wa\.me') desc_avec_tel_ou_wame, count(*) filter (where photos::text ~ 'fbcdn|scontent') photo_fbcdn, count(*) filter (where length(titre) < 12) titre_court from annonces_classifiees where actif
immo_qualite: select count(*) actives, count(*) filter (where quartier ~* 'cfa|fcfa|\d{5,}') quartier_est_un_prix, count(*) filter (where type_bien ilike 'terrain%' and transaction='location') terrain_en_location, count(*) filter (where description is null or length(description)<40) desc_courte_ou_vide, count(*) filter (where photos is null or cardinality(photos)=0) sans_photo from annonces_immo where actif and not coalesce(rejete,false) and coalesce(prix,0)>=10000
immo_min_prix_landing: select type_bien, transaction, count(*) n, min(prix) min_prix, percentile_cont(0.1) within group (order by prix) p10 from annonces_immo where actif and not coalesce(rejete,false) and prix>=10000 and (type_bien in ('chambre','studio','appartement','maison','villa','terrain')) group by 1,2 order by 1,2
boutiques_visibles: select count(*) n, count(*) filter (where nom ~ '\d{5,}') nom_suffixe_numerique, count(*) filter (where nom ~* 'test|audit|demo') nom_test from boutiques where actif
categories_produits: select coalesce(c.nom, 'sans') cat, count(*) n from produits p left join categories c on c.id=p.categorie_id where p.nb_offres>0 group by 1 order by 2 desc
